source.method: Original ASM note score translation with call/loop expansion; no ROM/emulator.
source.timing: Integer frame delays + original 8-bit fractional accumulation. Channels loop independently.
limitations: WebAudio timbre depends on the renderer; duty patterns, vibrato, envelopes and pitch slides are exported as metadata.
Loop phase is recorded once; repeated hardware-frame fractional carry may differ by a frame.
SFX and Pokémon cries are not included in this music score file.
